newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher on Dow, dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher on Dow, dollar.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning trade on Friday as participants were encouraged by firmness in the New York stock market and the yen's fall against the dollar overnight, brokers said.
The brokers also said that a decline in selling by arbitrageurs helped buyers prevail.
As of 0015 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was up 210.02 points, or 1.09 percent, at 19,432.64. Its September futures were up 140 points to 19,420.
Participants were continuing to pick up shares of makers of memory chip production equipment, the brokers said.
However, they said they expect some dealers to sell to adjust long positions ahead of the weekend.
